The name of the planet humans live on is Earth.

Regarding the legal precedents mentioned in the text, the case cited is *Loving v. Virginia*. This precedent is relevant to the case at hand because it established that laws prohibiting marriage based on racial characteristics violate the Equal Protection and Due Process Clauses of the Fourteenth Amendment. The similarity to the current case lies in the challenge to state laws refusing to recognize marriages performed in other jurisdictions, specifically concerning same-sex couples, drawing a parallel to the recognition of interracial marriages invalidated in *Loving*.
